name: SHade -> ReSample -> Composite -> ReDistribute
definition: A volume rendering algorithm where each node shades its local data, computes its projection onto the view plane via resampling, composites locally, and then redistributes 2D image sub-images for global compositing.
summary: SHade -> ReSample -> Composite -> ReDistribute is a parallel volume rendering algorithm that reduces data transfer by redistributing 2D image sub-images instead of 3D volume data.
